note: Equal time → ratio of capitals. Equal capital → ratio of times.

text: Partner's share = (his capital-months ÷ total capital-months) × total profit
Total profit = known share × (sum of ratio parts) ÷ (his ratio part)
note: For questions that give one partner's share and ask for the total.

text: Joins after m months (of a 12-month year) → invests for (12 − m) months
note: 'At the end of 7 months' means he is in for the remaining 5 months.

text: Capital that changes: add up (capital × months at that capital) for each stretch
note: A withdrawal after 4 months of ₹20,000 from ₹80,000 → 80,000×4 + 60,000×8.

text: Working partner's total = commission + his ratio share of the balance, where balance = profit − commission
note: The commission comes out before the ratio split. Never take his ratio share of the full profit.

text: If a animals of type A eat as much as b animals of type B, then 1 A = (b/a) B
note: 3 cows = 7 goats means a cow counts as 7/3 goat (a cow is the bigger eater).
